moat_hypotheses.title: Service upgrade jobs have repeat final-inspection risk patterns
moat_hypotheses.business_problem: Final inspection failures on service upgrades create repeat truck rolls and delayed payments.
moat_hypotheses.local_signal: Dallas residential service upgrade permits paired with inspection sequences and result notes.
moat_hypotheses.evidence_we_expect: Higher fail rates for service panel and meter-base work, especially when the first follow-up happens within a short window.
moat_hypotheses.why_generic_models_miss_it: The failure modes depend on Dallas-local inspection patterns and the company's actual correction history, not generic electrical advice.
moat_hypotheses.value_if_true: A job-type-specific readiness checklist could reduce avoidable failed finals and speed cash collection.
moat_hypotheses.test_plan: Run next-inspection-outcome and recommended-next-action evals on service-upgrade permits first.

moat_hypotheses.title: Failed inspection notes can be normalized into a reusable correction playbook
moat_hypotheses.business_problem: Correction knowledge currently lives in texts and crew memory.
moat_hypotheses.local_signal: Inspector notes, field correction messages, and failed-to-passed reinspection sequences.
moat_hypotheses.evidence_we_expect: A small set of repeated issue categories such as grounding, panel labeling, scope mismatch, and incomplete work.
moat_hypotheses.why_generic_models_miss_it: The exact note style and correction sequence are local and company-specific, especially when notes are short or messy.
moat_hypotheses.value_if_true: The business can standardize reinspection prep and shorten time to pass.
moat_hypotheses.test_plan: Label a small sample of failed inspections with the schema vocabulary and score failure-reason plus next-action tasks.

moat_hypotheses.title: ZIP-level housing stock patterns change the most likely correction path
moat_hypotheses.business_problem: Crews lose time when older homes need corrections that were not anticipated in the estimate.
moat_hypotheses.local_signal: Permit addresses, ZIP codes, and repeated failure reasons grouped by neighborhood slice.
moat_hypotheses.evidence_we_expect: Certain ZIP codes show recurring panel, grounding, or service-equipment correction patterns.
moat_hypotheses.why_generic_models_miss_it: Neighborhood-specific housing stock and local inspector behavior are not captured in general model knowledge.
moat_hypotheses.value_if_true: Estimating, truck prep, and pre-inspection checklists can be tailored by area.
moat_hypotheses.test_plan: Use pattern-extraction tasks on grouped permit and inspection slices by ZIP code and job type.

discovery_summary.business_snapshot: North Oak Residential Electric is a small Dallas residential electrical contractor doing service upgrades, remodel wiring, EV charger installs, and repair work. The business already captures permit numbers, inspection dates, and some correction context, but the reusable lessons are fragmented across text threads, office notes, and crew memory.
likely_moat_candidates: Service-upgrade and panel-related jobs appear likely to have repeat final-inspection risk patterns.
Failed inspection notes can likely be normalized into a small correction playbook that the company does not currently store well.
Neighborhood and housing-stock differences may change which correction path is most likely by ZIP code.
discovery_summary.best_first_eval: The best first eval is `recommended_next_action`. It is the most business-legible task and only needs a reviewed sample of failed-to-passed sequences plus correction notes. It also creates immediate operational value if the output quality is strong.
most_important_missing_data: Better capture of failed inspection notes
A reviewed mapping from raw notes to normalized failure reasons
Clear records of what changed between a failed inspection and the next pass
next_weeks_recommendations: Assemble 25 to 50 failed or partial Dallas residential electrical inspections with their follow-up outcomes.
Review those rows into the `failure_reason_normalized` and action vocabularies already defined in `schema.md` and `evals.md`.
Use that reviewed sample as the seed dataset for the first local `recommended_next_action` and `failure_reason_classification` task files.
